You are a CI worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge, detached at HEAD. Edit files ONLY under the current working directory; NEVER edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly (you may only run its .venv/bin/python). Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git. No network. Write short notes to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/game-reimagination-phase1-notes/cifast-notes.md.

CONTEXT: Brandon says the slow test loop cripples the rework. CI job `fast-feedback` in .github/workflows/test.yml runs `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q --no-cov -n 4 -m "(unit or component) and not authoring_quality"`, which takes about 147 s and duplicates work the six shard jobs do, so it is now the longest job. scripts/quick_suite.py (read it, and docs/testing-runbook.md section 1) runs pytest on everything except files recorded at 15 s or more in tests/shard_durations.json, and passes arguments after `--` to pytest. Decision: the fast feedback job becomes the intersection, so it is fast and still a cheap early signal; the six shard jobs keep running every test, so nothing is dropped from CI.

GOAL: (1) In .github/workflows/test.yml change ONLY the run line of the `Run fast feedback tests` step to: TMPDIR=/tmp uv run python scripts/quick_suite.py -- -n 4 -m "(unit or component) and not authoring_quality" . Check quick_suite.py's argument handling so that this exact command works (it already sets -n auto by default; the later -n 4 must win or be harmless on a 4-core runner; if the script rejects it, pass the arguments in the form it supports and say so). Rename nothing: keep the job id, job name and the required-check names exactly, because branch protection may reference them. (2) Update docs/testing-runbook.md where it describes the CI fast-feedback job or its command (grep for `fast`), in place, one line; do not add results. (3) Verify locally: run the exact quick_suite.py command with the .venv python instead of `uv run python`, confirm it passes, and report its wall time and the number of tests selected, and, with `--list`, the skipped files. Confirm with a YAML parse (python -c with yaml if available, otherwise a careful read) that the workflow is still valid and that no other line of the workflow changed (report `git diff --stat`).

OWNED FILES: .github/workflows/test.yml, docs/testing-runbook.md. Nothing else.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Do not run uv. Full suite must end green: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto.

NOTES CONTRACT: cifast-notes.md with sections: CHANGE (the old and new run line), QUICK_SUITE COMPAT (any adjustment), LOCAL VERIFY (command, tests selected, wall time), DIFF (stat), OPEN QUESTIONS (or 'none'). Reply with a short summary.
